$description: Calendar system fixtures — real-world legal case scenario. Covers all event categories, standalone + event-attached reminders, and all reminder statuses. Case ID 42 assumed.

calendar_events.title: Deposition — Jane Smith (Plaintiff)
calendar_events.description:
Remote deposition via Zoom. Prepare Exhibit A (medical records) and Exhibit C (expert report). Jane is the key witness on damages. Expect 3-4 hours.

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
Meeting ID: 123 456 789
Passcode: sent via email

calendar_events.title: Motion for Summary Judgment Hearing
calendar_events.description:
Oral argument before Judge Chen. Plaintiff filed MSJ on negligence per se. We must be prepared to argue genuine dispute of material fact on causation.

Courtroom 4B, Fulton County Superior Court
185 Central Ave SW, Atlanta, GA 30303
calendar_events.location: Courtroom 4B — Fulton County Superior Court, 185 Central Ave SW, Atlanta, GA 30303

calendar_events.title: Discovery Cutoff Deadline
calendar_events.description:
All discovery must be completed by this date. Outstanding items:
- Interrogatories to Plaintiff (responses due 7/30)
- Expert witness disclosures
- Document production from third-party medical providers

calendar_events.title: Client Strategy Meeting
calendar_events.description:
Weekly sync with the client to review case progress. Agenda:
1. Deposition prep review
2. MSJ opposition status
3. Settlement discussion — plaintiff's latest offer
4. Budget update for expert witnesses

calendar_events.title: File Response to Plaintiff's Motion in Limine
calendar_events.description: Plaintiff seeks to exclude our expert's testimony on industry standards. Must file opposition brief and supporting affidavit from Dr. Reeves. 25-page limit per local rules.

calendar_events.title: Mediation Session
calendar_events.description:
Court-ordered mediation with Judge Peterson (Ret.). Both parties to submit mediation statements by 8/20. Client must be present in person.

JAMS Atlanta Resolution Center
1201 W Peachtree St NW, Suite 2500
Atlanta, GA 30309
calendar_events.location: JAMS Atlanta — 1201 W Peachtree St NW, Suite 2500, Atlanta, GA 30309

reminders.title: Prep for Jane Smith Deposition
reminders.description: Review Exhibit A (medical records) and Exhibit C (expert report). Prepare cross-examination outline. Confirm Zoom link is working. Send calendar invite to client.

reminders.title: Finalize MSJ Opposition Brief
reminders.description: Complete final draft of opposition to summary judgment. Must be filed at least 5 days before hearing per local rules. Review statement of material facts for accuracy.

reminders.title: Follow up on third-party medical records subpoena
reminders.description: Subpoena served on Piedmont Hospital 30 days ago. No response yet. Call records custodian at (404) 555-0100. If no response, prepare motion to compel.

reminders.title: Check statute of limitations for cross-claim
reminders.description: Potential counterclaim for indemnification against co-defendant. Verify whether limitations period has run. If viable, draft and file before discovery cutoff on 9/15.

reminders.title: Send engagement letter update to client
reminders.description: Original engagement letter capped fees at $50K. We're approaching $42K. Send updated fee estimate for discovery phase (estimated additional $25-35K through trial). Must get signed acknowledgment.

reminders.title: Review plaintiff's settlement demand
reminders.description: Plaintiff sent demand letter for $750K. Evaluate against our exposure analysis. Prepare counter-offer range for client discussion at next strategy meeting.

reminders.title: Submit Mediation Statement
reminders.description: Prepare and submit confidential mediation statement to JAMS. Include: case summary, key evidence, settlement history, and negotiation position. 10-page limit.

edge_cases._note: The following scenarios are covered by the fixture data above:

all_day_event.description: Discovery Cutoff — all_day=true, end_time is null. Renders as a full-day banner in month view, no time label. Date derived from start_time::DATE.

timed_event_without_end.description: File Response deadline — has start_time but end_time is null. Renders as a point-in-time event showing only the start time. Date derived from start_time::DATE.

event_with_location.description: MSJ Hearing — has a physical location string. Renders with location icon in event detail.

event_with_virtual_location.description: Deposition — location contains a Zoom URL. Renders as a clickable link.

standalone_reminder.description: Subpoena follow-up — event_id is null. Appears in reminder list without linking to any calendar event.

event_attached_reminder.description: Prep for deposition — event_id=1. Appears nested under the deposition event in event detail view.

fired_reminder.description: Engagement letter — status='fired'. Appears with 'fired' badge, no longer triggers notification.

dismissed_reminder.description: Settlement demand — status='dismissed'. User manually dismissed. Renders with strikethrough or muted style.

agent_created.description: Events/reminders with created_by='agent' were created by the agent via chat tools. UI displays 'Agent' as creator.

user_created.description: Events/reminders with created_by='user' were created by a human user via the UI.
